title: Weeknight Doenjang Tofu Stew
summary: A bubbling pot of soybean-paste stew with soft tofu, zucchini and potato. Made with plain water so it stays vegetarian, and ready in about half an hour.

creator.bio: Sample creator. Korean home cooking the way my mom taught me: stews, banchan and noodles for busy nights.

ingredients.name: doenjang
ingredients.notes: brands vary in saltiness; start with 2 if yours is strong

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.preparation: peeled and cut into small cubes

steps.instruction: Cut the potato, onion and zucchini so everything is ready before the pot goes on.
success_cues: Potato cubes are roughly the same small size so they cook evenly
warnings: Sharp knife: curl your fingertips under and keep the board steady on a damp towel.

steps.instruction: Pour 3 cups of water into a small pot and whisk in the doenjang until no lumps remain. Add the potato, onion and garlic and bring to a boil over medium-high heat.
success_cues: Broth is evenly cloudy and tan with no paste clumps
warnings: Boiling water: pour away from you and use oven mitts on the pot handles.
steps.creator_note: Whisk the paste in before it gets hot. It dissolves much more easily in cold water.

steps.instruction: Lower to a lively simmer and cook for 8 minutes, until a potato cube gives easily when poked with a knife.
success_cues: A knife slides into a potato cube with little resistance

steps.instruction: Add the zucchini, tofu and gochugaru if using. Simmer 4 to 5 minutes more without stirring hard so the tofu stays in cubes.
success_cues: Zucchini is just tender and still bright green at the edges
Tofu is heated through and holding its shape

steps.instruction: Taste the broth; add a splash of water if too salty. Top with scallion and serve straight from the pot with rice.
success_cues: Broth tastes savory and rounded, not harsh
warnings: The pot and broth stay very hot; set it on a trivet and ladle carefully.
steps.creator_note: In my house this goes on the table still bubbling.

creator_notes: Leftovers taste even better the next day; reheat until simmering.
dietary_warnings: Contains soy (doenjang, tofu). Some doenjang brands contain wheat; check the label.
